branding.heroTitle: Make Tender Selection Faster, Fairer, and Smarter
branding.heroDescription: NirnayAI uses artificial intelligence to help government procurement teams review tenders quickly and fairly. Upload your tender documents, and let AI extract the requirements, evaluate companies against your criteria, and flag decisions that need your attention.
branding.uploadDesc: Simply upload your tender document. NirnayAI instantly analyzes it and extracts all the requirements companies must meet.
branding.extractDesc: The system automatically understands what you're looking for in bidders. You can review, edit, or add any requirements to make sure they're perfect.
branding.evaluateDesc: Upload company documents. NirnayAI checks each one against your requirements and tells you who qualifies.
branding.makeDesc: Review NirnayAI's suggestions for any borderline cases and make the final call with full confidence.
branding.reportDesc: Create official reports, download them, and officially approve the winners—all in one place.
branding.transparentDesc: See exactly how NirnayAI made each decision
branding.secureDesc: Your data is protected with modern security standards
branding.fairDesc: AI applies the same rules to every company equally
branding.fastDesc: Complete evaluations in minutes, not weeks
branding.assistantDesc: Think of NirnayAI as a helpful assistant who understands government procurement rules. It does the repetitive analysis work, so you can focus on what matters most—making the right decision for your organization.
branding.startDesc: Sign in and upload your first tender in minutes
